is .shape where we chain the type modifier?

## Short answer: no

The type/size modifiers belong on the component root, not on `.shape`.

In [plugins/pantoken/custom-components/src/components/skeleton-loader/skeleton-loader.css](plugins/pantoken/custom-components/src/components/skeleton-loader/skeleton-loader.css), the actual modifier selectors are:

- `&.-type-text`
- `&.-type-avatar`
- `&.-type-image`
- `&.-size-md`
- etc.

Those are all scoped under the root `&` inside the loader block, meaning:

- `.pfx-skeleton-loader.-type-avatar`
- `.pfx-skeleton-loader.-size-md`

and not:

- `.pfx-skeleton-loader .shape.-type-avatar`

`.shape` is just the visual part that gets the shimmer/background; the modifier drives the parent state and then the child shape inherits that state through the scope. So the right mental model is:

- `.pfx-skeleton-loader` = component state
- `.shape` = child part
- `.skeleton-row` = repeated row wrapper

If you want, I can tighten the API to make that convention even clearer by renaming or reordering the doc block and selectors to emphasize “root-level modifiers, child parts” more explicitly.
